bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AUSD has reviewed native issuance deployments across the Agora EVM family, Solana Token-2022, and Sui; Ethereum is the canonical home chain. LayerZero's OFT burn/mint rail is bridge machinery: the verified Ethereum AgoraMintBurnOFTAdapter (0x9CaB7Ede13dc56652E44D2404E969C212f22689b) holds the EVM BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE, and its owner, pause, rate-limit, peer, and proxy-admin surfaces are structured below under Bridge Risk rather than Mint Authority. Plasma is AUSD0, a distinct LayerZero bridge representation rather than native Agora issuance; Plume retains a reviewed native-issuance route. The route is externally validated and supply-conserving at the bridge level, but exact current peers, DVN/validator configuration, and destination-specific rate limits remain explicit evidence gaps. The 2024 Wormhole NTT integration was superseded by LayerZero OFT.

controls.label: AUSD Ethereum LayerZero MintBurnOFTAdapter
controls.capDescription: The verified AgoraMintBurnOFTAdapter holds the AUSD BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE and burns source AUSD/mints destination AUSD after LayerZero delivery. The adapter cannot change its own rolling rate limit; the bridge route's owner and rate-limit manager are separate control surfaces.
